rdfs:label: Email
rdfs:comment: Deprecated vCard Email class (owl:deprecated in the W3C vCard ontology) — formerly the type of an email-address node.
notes: vcard:Email is deprecated in the W3C vCard ontology ("Use the hasEmail object property"). Use `urn:solid:hasEmail` directly to a `mailto:` IRI, or, for typed emails, the SolidOS pattern: `hasEmail` -> a node typed `vcard:Home`/`vcard:Work` carrying `vcard:value <mailto:...>`; the node need not be typed Email. Note that upstream `vcard:value` is declared a datatype property, though SolidOS uses it with a mailto: IRI.

examples.title: Use instead: a typed work email without the Email class

history.note: Initial term — Class form pairing with the existing hasEmail property.
Deprecated (vcard:Email is owl:deprecated upstream); supersededBy hasEmail, notes describe the typed-node pattern, Email dropped from example @type.
